patch_resolves_note: The staged patch updates the local-header extra-field parse call from `parseExtraField(buffer, handledextralen, true, pfi)` to `parseExtraField(buffer, n, true, pfi)`, so the fixed original still executes the parser call but no longer overstates the initialized extent of `buffer` after a short read.

relation.description: Source identity relation for the vulnerability-relevant value.

nodes.description: First project-code read that materializes the attacker-controlled fixed local ZIP header body after the start-of-file scan finds the first PK\x03\x04 signature and openArchive skips the 2-byte 'version needed to extract' field. These 24 bytes contain the namelen and extralen fields that drive the short extra-field read.

openArchive passes the requested extra-field length handledextralen instead of the actual byte count returned by dev->read. When the extra-field read is short, parseExtraField is told that unread bytes in buffer are valid input, so it walks past the initialized prefix into uninitialized stack memory. The patch fixes this exact obligation by passing n.
MSan crash site. On the seventh parseExtraField iteration, fieldsize is assembled from the uninitialized tail of KZip::openArchive's stack buffer and then consumed by the comparison against size.

edges.description: The same stack buffer base pointer passed from `KZip::openArchive` into `parseExtraField` is the parser input whose later `fieldsize` load reaches the sink.
